title: Pure Barrier Statue
summary: Barrier Statue is an anti-meta stun archetype where each Level 4 monster locks both players out of Special Summoning monsters of all Attributes except its own. Supported by protection and ATK-boosting Equip Spells like Moon Mirror Shield, Ties of the Brethren, and Inspector Boarder, a single Barrier Statue can completely shut down modern combo decks.

allow.Inspector Boarder: Level 4 Machine stun monster that restricts monster effect activations based on monster card types on the field.
allow.Thunder King Rai-Oh: Level 4 Thunder stun partner that prevents adding cards from Deck to hand and sends itself to negate a Special Summon.
allow.Denko Sekka: Level 4 Thunder stun partner that prevents setting Spells/Traps or activating Set Spell/Trap Cards.
allow.Moon Mirror Shield: Equip Spell that guarantees any Barrier Statue wins every battle by setting its ATK/DEF to the opponent's monster + 100.
allow.Mage Power: Equip Spell that grants up to 2500 ATK/DEF to a Barrier Statue based on the number of Spell/Traps you control.
allow.Safe Zone: Continuous Trap that makes a face-up Barrier Statue untargetable and indestructible by battle or opponent's card effects.
allow.Solemn Judgment: Counter Trap that protects the Barrier Statue and backrow from board wipes like Harpie's Feather Duster or Lightning Storm.

main: Prevents both players from Special Summoning any monsters, except LIGHT monsters.
Prevents both players from Special Summoning any monsters, except DARK monsters.
Prevents monster effect activations up to the number of Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, Pendulum, and Link monsters.
Prevents both players from adding cards from the Deck to hand except by drawing, and negates an inherent Special Summon.
While you have no Set Spells/Traps, neither player can Set cards or activate Set cards in the Spell & Trap Zone.
Ensures your 1000 ATK Barrier Statue cannot be run over in battle and recycles itself to the Deck.
Turns any Barrier Statue into a 3000+ ATK beatstick alongside a full backrow.
Grants complete battle and card effect destruction immunity to a Barrier Statue.
Pays half your LP to negate any Summon or Spell/Trap that threatens your Barrier Statue.
